7592392736.name: Canna Cure 0.7g Dime Bag Purple Zkittlez
7592392736.description: Purple Zkittlez, is a indica cross of Purple Punch and The Original Z, delivering a robust flavor profile coupled with a powerful high. Its stunning purple shades highlight the trichomes, resulting in a grape-forward, fruity spectrum of delightful tastes. For enthusiasts of classic purple strains, this is an excellent new variety to become enamored with. Consumers describe the effects as being happy, relaxed, and sometimes sleepy.

9811454538.name: Canna Cure 0.7g Dime Bag Strawberry Diesel
9811454538.description: Small but mighty, this Canna Cure Dime Bag packs bold flavor and smooth potency into a perfect 0.7g size. Strawberry Diesel brings a sweet berry aroma with a kick of fuel, delivering a uplifting sativa experience that hits just right whenever you need a quick, quality session.

9811454225.name: Canna Cure 3.5g Flower Blockberry
9811454225.description: Block Berry, also known as “Blockberry” or “BlockBerry,” is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the delicious Black Cherry Punch X Tropicana Cookies strains. A super tasty bud that will have you begging for just one more delightful toke, Block Berry is a fantastic hybrid for any lover of sweet treats. The taste of Block Berry is truly a delight, with a sweet and sugary blueberry flavor accented by hints of citrusy oranges, creamy vanilla and dark chocolate.

9811454227.name: Canna Cure 3.5g Flower Blue Zushi
9811454227.description: Blue Zushi is a indica dominant hybrid strain known for its vibrant, frosty buds and a complex aroma blending earthy, floral, sweet, and citrus notes. Prized for its relaxing and euphoric effects, it offers a smooth experience ideal for unwinding or enhancing creativity.

10763949189.name: Cheevo 28g Flower Purple Starfruit
10763949189.description: Purple Starfruit stands out with vibrant purple hues, uniform, and dense bud eye-catching buds. It combines a striking bag appeal with a rich berry‑earthy‑herbal aroma profile. This variety is bred to deliver a strong, memorable high that eases you into relaxation without dragging you down.

11118929683.name: Cheevo 7g Ground Flower Blueberry Diesel
11118929683.description: Sweet berry sweetness meets pungent fuel funk. This uplifting sativa delivers an energetic, cerebral high with a boost of focus and creativity, balanced by a mellow, fruity finish ideal for daytime activity.

11118930106.name: Cheevo 7g Ground Flower Cheddar Cheeze
11118930106.description: A hybrid with savory, funky cheese aroma with sweet, creamy notes and an earthy backdrop.

10741848414.name: Claybourne Co Classic Cuts 3.5g Flower Durban Poison
10741848414.description: Classic Cuts, A selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from a lineage of tried and true genetics. Always hand-trimmed, always grown indoors. This pure sativa originates from the South African port city of Durban. It has gained popularity worldwide for its sweet smell and energetic, uplifting effects. Durban Poison is the perfect strain to help you stay productive through a busy day, when exploring the outdoors, or to lend a spark of creativity. Growers and concentrate enthusiasts will both enjoy the over-sized resin glands which make this strain a quality choice for concentrate extraction. The buds are round and chunky, and leave a thick coating of trichomes on almost all areas of the plant.

11541948367.name: Claybourne Co Classic Cuts 3.5g Flower Kush Mints
11541948367.description: Classic Cuts, A selection of classic and modern classic varieties curated from a lineage of tried and true genetics. Always hand-trimmed, always grown indoors

10741847687.name: Claybourne Co Gold Cuts 3.5g Flower Lemon Drop Top
10741847687.description: Exclusive and unique genetics from Claybourne’s breeding and selection program. Gold Cuts are hand-trimmed on the stem, using minimal touch processing for maximum trichome preservation.

11541950029.name: Claybourne Co Gold Cuts 3.5g Flower The Judge
11541950029.description:
Exclusive and unique genetics from Claybourne’s breeding and selection program. Gold Cuts are hand-trimmed on the stem, using minimal touch processing for maximum trichome preservation.

We call this strain “The Judge” because it frickin’ rules. The Judge is an indica with a distinct diesel aroma juxtaposed by its coffee and plum flavor. The pungent smell, coming from its Chem Dawg lineage, is offset by the fact it’s our highest testing strain ever, proving that The Judge is indeed stern, but more than fair.

9651861816.name: Florist Farms 7g Flower King Sherb
9651861816.description: King Sherb is an indica known for its soothing, mood-elevating effects that begin with a gentle wave of euphoria before melting into a heavy, tranquil body high. Perfect for winding down in the evening, easing stress, or settling in for a restful night, this strain offers a smooth, flavorful smoke with a slow-building potency that lingers comfortably.

11141587131.name: Florist Farms 7g Flower Private Party
11141587131.description: A balanced Hybrid strain known for uplifting, balancing, and energizing effects, perfect for social settings, with sweet, sour citrus and strong gas/diesel aromas and flavors, grown organically in New York. It provides a feel-good, creative vibe without being overpowering, thanks to its blend of Zkittlez S1 and AVL genetics.

11141587106.name: Florist Farms 7g Flower Purple Boof
11141587106.description: Hybrid with fruity and skunky with spicy undertones

11141587338.name: Florist Farms 7g Flower Tropicana Cookies
11141587338.description: Sativa with a citrusy flavor and a waffle cone finish

8169989015.name: 5Boro 1.5g Blunt Amnesia Haze
8169989015.description:
Hemp wrapped blunt filled with 1.5 grams of premium cannabis. Glass tip provides unrestricted airflow from start to finish.

Strain Type: Sativa

Terpenes: A-Bisabolol, Borneol, A-Humulene, Guaiol

Lineage: Original Haze crossed with several different original landraces

Effects: Amnesia Haze may actually drive inspiration rather than forgetfulness. This strain makes for a well-balanced, albeit somewhat cerebral high, with an uplifting energetic boost.

Aromas/Flavors: This unique terpene profile will leave you tasting a sweet nutty flavor with a citrus undertone.

10529429017.name: 5Boro 1.5g Blunt Cereal Milk
10529429017.description:
Hemp wrapped blunt filled with 1.5 grams of premium cannabis. Glass tip provides unrestricted airflow from start to finish.

Strain Type: Hybrid

Effects: Evenly balanced hybrid strain with euphoric effects

Aromas/Flavors: Sweet, creamy flavor reminiscent of milk left over after eating cereal.

11518999807.name: 5Boro 1.5g Blunt Hood Candy
11518999807.description:
Hemp wrapped blunt filled with 1.5 grams of premium cannabis. Glass tip provides unrestricted airflow from start to finish.

Strain Type: Indica

Terpenes: B-Caryophyllene, Limonene, B-Myrcene, A-Humulene, B-Pinene

Effects: Hood Candyz is great for unwinding at end of the day of a long day. Effects include heavy body relaxation, mental relief, and powerful munchies.

Aromas/Flavors: Extremely sweet and fruity with small hints of gassy floral notes.

11518999768.name: Alibi 1g Rosin Infused Preroll Royal Cherry Kush x Crazy Train
11518999768.description:
This is a ceramic tipped preroll, with 1 gram of ground Royal Cherry Kush flower, injected with a Live rosin extracted from Crazy Train cannabis.

Strain Type: Hybrid Dominant

Effects: Potent hybrid effects consisting of creative insight and energy, followed by powerful munchies and body relaxation

Aromas/Flavors: A delicious twist between the gassy, cherry flavors of the flower and the lemon-lime taste of the rosin.

11518999948.name: Alibi 1g Rosin Infused Preroll Super Silver Haze x Tropical Cooler
11518999948.description:
This is a ceramic tipped preroll, with 1 gram of ground Super Silver Haze flower, injected with a Live rosin extracted from Tropical Cooler cannabis.

Strain Type: Sativa Dominant

Effects: Potent Sativa effects consisting of deep creative insight and a powerful feeling of energy that makes you want to get things done.

Aromas/Flavors: A delicious twist between the earthy, citrus flavors of the flower and the sweet-tropical taste of the rosin.

10827601227.name: All That Chocolate Big Buzz Blunt Shotgun Sugar

8538431340.name: Ayrloom 5pk 0.6g Infused Prerolls Pink Rozay
8538431340.description: like sipping on a bright + floral glass of rosé wine, but without the hangover. unwind + reach a higher buzz with relaxing effects.

9091611783.name: Baby Jeeter 5pk 0.5g Infused Prerolls Apples and Bananas
9091611783.description: Apples and Bananas is an evenly balanced and delicious hybrid strain. When it comes to the flavor of this bud, the name says it all. Apples and Bananas packs a sweet and fruity taste that's filled with delicious sugary bananas and sharply sour apples, with a touch of black pepper to it. The aroma takes a spicier turn, with a sharp punch of savory diesel. The Apples and Bananas high is just as delicious, with full-bodied sensations that hit hard and leave you dazed. You'll feel the heady tingling almost immediately, lifting your mind into a state of happy euphoria accompanied by a boost of creativity.

9091611847.name: Baby Jeeter 5pk 0.5g Infused Prerolls Pink Lemon
9091611847.description: Pink Lemon is a hybrid Strain. The high is very relaxing but not sleepy. It's a bit of a creeper starting with a very nice clean head high with an energy boost. It puts you in a positive mood with positive thoughts. An evenly balanced hybrid that still allows you to function. The aroma is sweet raspberry and lemon. On the dry hit you taste sweet raspberry with a little bit of candy citrus. The flavor is fruity, sweet raspberry with candy citrus notes and some grapefruit on exhale.

9091611795.name: Baby Jeeter 5pk 0.5g Infused Prerolls Skywalker OG
9091611795.description: Prepare for liftoff and sink into deep relaxation with Jeeter’s Skywalker OG Infused Pre-Roll. This premium indica preroll combines top-shelf whole flower, potent cannabis oil, and a generous kief coating to deliver an ultra-smooth, slow-burning experience that hits hard and lasts long. Skywalker OG is a powerful indica-dominant strain known for its earthy, spicy flavor profile and deeply relaxing, body-heavy effects. Ideal for evening use, this pre-roll is your go-to for stress relief, pain management, and restful sleep, perfect for winding down after a long day. Jeeter’s infused pre-rolls are crafted with care, using only premium flower (never shake or trim), ensuring a consistent, flavorful, and highly potent smoke every time.

10763949234.name: Cheevo 7pk 1g Prerolls Blue Dream
10763949234.description: A sativa with sweet blueberry aromatics meld with earthy pine undertones.

10763949147.name: Cheevo 7pk 1g Prerolls Hypnotik
10763949147.description: Hypnotik is a sativa-dominant hybrid cannabis strain typically created by crossing MAC and Gorilla Diesel #3 with sweet berry, cake, and subtle citrus or lemon notes

10054748896.description: Frost Around & Find Out! These super tasty half gram pre-rolls are THCa Diamond Frosted, Terpene Enhanced, and made from Premium Indoor, Full Nug Flower Infused with Liquid Diamonds. Each Frosted Flyer is highly potent and packed with nonstop flavor all the way down to the crutch. Available In: (2.5g) 5-Packs.

7613288961.name: MFNY 4pk 0.75g Live Resin Infused Prerolls Sour Diesel x Sour Diesel
7613288961.description:
Elevate your pre-roll experience with MFNY Sour Diesel Live Resin Infused 4pk – 0.75g, crafted for bold flavor and enhanced potency. Infused with premium live resin, these pre-rolls deliver a terpene-rich, full-spectrum experience with smooth, consistent burns.

Sour Diesel is a legendary sativa known for its pungent diesel aroma, bright citrus notes, and earthy undertones. This infused format amplifies both flavor and effects, providing a more robust and long-lasting session compared to standard pre-rolls.

As a sativa, it offers an energizing, uplifting high that boosts focus, creativity, and mood, perfect for daytime use or active, social settings.

7888343805.name: Revert 0.5g Preroll Cherry Swirl
7888343805.description: Cherry Swirl is a smooth, sun-grown hybrid with rich cherry sweetness layered over subtle earth and cream. This strain delivers a balanced experience that starts with a gentle cerebral lift and settles into an easy, relaxed body feel. Approachable and versatile, Cherry Swirl is well-suited for daytime or early evening sessions when you want flavor, clarity, and calm without feeling weighed down.

7593954912.name: Revert 0.5g Preroll Godfather OG
7593954912.description: Godfather OG, also known as "Godfather," "The Don of All OG's," and "OG Godfather," is a potent indica marijuana strain made by crossing XXX OG and Alpha OG. The effects of this strain are sedating and relaxing. This strain features a flavor profile that is spicy and kushy, with undertones of subtle grape. Consumers with a low THC tolerance should only smoke Godfather OG in small doses due to its high THC levels, which hover around 28%. This strain won 1st place for Best Indica at the 2013 Cannabis Cup in Los Angeles.

7593955032.name: Revert 0.5g Preroll Grapelato
7593955032.description: Grapelato is a smooth, flavor-forward hybrid that blends sweet grape and creamy dessert notes with subtle earthiness. This strain delivers a relaxed, uplifting experience that starts with a light cerebral buzz and settles into a calm, comfortable body feel. Easygoing and balanced, Grapelato is great for social settings, creative moments, or unwinding without feeling heavy.

8778724644.name: Rolling Green 1g Preroll Green Crack
8778724644.description: Flavors: Citrus zest, sweet mango, pineapple, earthy finish Effects: Energizing, focused, uplifting Great For: Daytime use, productivity, staying active Type: Sativa‑leaning Hybrid

8778724646.name: Rolling Green 1g Preroll Super Lemon Haze
8778724646.description:
Flavors: Sweet lemon candy, soft lavender, peppery spice

Effects: Uplifting, energetic, clear-headed

Great For: Daytime use, social settings, staying productive

Type: Sativa‑leaning Hybrid

7991640210.name: Stone Road 1g Infused Preroll Space Cake
7991640210.description: Space Cake offers the signature creamy flavor profile of a cake strain, backed by bright notes of fresh fruit and berries. This indica varietal is infused with hash and diamonds, enhancing its potency and flavor profile.

10740341557.name: Bonanza 2g Disposable Baja Splash
10740341557.description: This Indica dominant strain has a tropical flavor profile, with hints of hibiscus and exotic fruits. This will allow users to feel relaxed, happy and sleepy, perfect for evening time use.

5909741663.name: Bonanza 2g Disposable Strawberry Lemonade
5909741663.description: A hybrid product that is described as having a perfect balance of tart and sweet, with mood-elevating, energetic, and creative effects.

8162015340.description: Take a trip to the tropics with the Bonanza Maui Wowie, a classic sativa that has been delighting cannabis lovers since the 1960s. Known for its sweet pineapple aroma, tropical fruit flavors, and smooth earthy undertones, this cart delivers a bright, energizing experience that’s perfect for daytime enjoyment.

11118930440.name: Florette Live Resin 0.5g Disposable GG#4

11118930432.name: Florette Live Resin 0.5g Disposable Original Sangria

7950475558.name: Jaunty 1g Cartridge Cherry Pie

5663135311.name: Jaunty 1g Cartridge Green Crack
5663135311.description: A potent sativa blend with ~90% THC, offering a sweet, tropical citrus flavor with earthy notes, known for delivering an energetic, uplifting, creative, and focused cerebral high, ideal for daytime motivation, featuring terpenes like Myrcene, Limonene, and Humulene in a 510-thread cartridge.

5663135381.name: Jaunty 1g Cartridge Pineapple Express

6486846660.name: Jaunty 1g Live Resin Cartridge GG4

6971645163.name: Jaunty 1g Live Resin Cartridge Gelato33

5663135459.name: Jaunty 1g Live Resin Cartridge Heir Heads
5663135459.description: a full-spectrum, indica-dominant experience with fruity, herbal, and spiced apple notes from its Apples & Bananas x Runtz lineage, delivering powerful, relaxing effects with a true-to-plant flavor thanks to flash-frozen flower and clean BHO extraction, ensuring bold aromas and a smooth, potent vape for calm relaxation

5663135436.name: Jaunty 1g Live Resin Cartridge Nimbus Snacks

10164871063.name: Jaunty 1g Live Resin Cartridge Tropical Z

5883112824.name: All That Chocolate 50mg Lions Mane Infused Dark Chocolate

9351054907.name: Ayrloom 100mg Gummies Dream Weaver Sugar Plum
9351054907.description: sweet dreams await. sweet plum, cozy spice, + rest-supporting cannabinoids come together to soften your night. crafted to catch the chaos of your day + ease you into rest, dreamweaver is woven with calming cbn, your gentle guide to dreamland. fast acting, gluten free, vegan.

8538430645.name: Ayrloom 100mg Gummies Orchard Sunrise Apple
8538430645.description: every orchard sunrise means a new day + a new opportunity. we pay homage to our orchard’s 110-year-old history + nod hello to the future with our apple flavored cannabis infused gummies. they combine flavors of our most beloved apples for a crisp + juicy profile. infused with b3, b6 + b12 for an extra boost! fast acting, gluten free, vegan.

8538430592.name: Ayrloom 100mg Gummies Pillow Talk Blueberry Lavender
8538430592.description: we believe that nothing beats a good night’s sleep. with flavors of just-picked blueberries + pure lavender, pillow talk is a sleep essential. make all the zzz’s count + be ready to dream big! fast acting, gluten free, vegan.

8970985175.name: CANOPI THC Elixir 100mg Bottle
8970985175.description:
CANOPI is a cannabis elixir designed to be sipped straight or mixed into your favorite drinks. All-natural, shelf-stable, and crafted with precision, each 30ml serving delivers 6mg of THC for thoughtful adult use. This 100mg bottle contains roughly 17 doses worth of elixir! Mix into tea, seltzer, or mocktails Build your own ritual!

5663135593.description: An indica based white chocolate edible featuring crushed cookies and cream, designed for a balanced experience, offering sweet, crunchy flavors with 10mg THC per piece (10 pieces total) for focus or general enjoyment.

7180506402.name: Calamity Jane 100mg Chocolates Sundown
7180506402.description: Rich dark chocolate that’s smooth, creamy, and reliable that is perfect for those looking to be relaxed and even sleepy, making these perfect for evening use.

8223382091.name: Camino 100mg Gummies Freshly Squeezed
8223382091.description:
Picture this: You've just wrapped up a hectic workday, your mind is racing with thoughts, and your body is feeling tense. This is the perfect occasion to reach for Camino Freshly Squeezed Recover gummies. Each gummy contains 5MG of THC and 10MG of CBG, along with hybrid-like terpenes that work together to create a harmonious blend of relaxation and balance.

CBG, known for its potential anti-inflammatory and anti-anxiety effects, helps balance out THC’s psychoactive experience. It's like having a gentle hand guiding you through, ensuring that you stay grounded and centered.

Camino Freshly Squeezed Recover gummies aren't just a treat for your tastebuds; they're a ticket to a serene state of mind. Embrace the relaxation and respite they offer.

6918806592.name: Camino 100mg Sour Gummies Raspberry Lemonade
6918806592.description: For those moments when you want to make a great experience even more joyous, like hanging with friends at the beach or enjoying a comedy show,  enter Camino Sours Raspberry Lemonade Bliss gummies. These delightful treats are designed to boost your mood and create a blissful experience no matter where you are and what you’re up to. Each delectable gummy is infused with 10MG of THC and a tailored blend of hybrid-like terpenes that marries perfectly with the sweet, tangy notes of ripe raspberries and the flavors of fresh, sugary lemonade. Welcome to your happy place!

8223382102.name: Camino 100mg Sour Gummies Strawberry Sunset
8223382102.description: Kick back dockside and relax to the rhythmic sounds of soft waves lapping against the shoreline. Indica-like terpenes meet a refreshing strawberry citrus flavor in this marvelously mellow edible. Take a deep breath in and chill out.

7199141117.name: Camino Chews 100mg Edibles Boysenberry
7199141117.description: Imagine slipping into a peaceful evening, where the stresses of the day gradually fade away, and the rising moon gently ushers you toward restful sleep. This is the perfect time to reach for Camino Chews Boysenberry ‘Sleep’, crafted to help you unwind and drift off effortlessly. Each sweet fruit chew is infused with a soothing blend of 10MG THC and 5MG CBN enhanced by chamomile and lavender extracts plus indica-like terpenes.

7199140889.name: Camino Chews 100mg Edibles Golden Peach
7199140889.description: Relief is closer than you think. Whether you’re dealing with the morning after a big night out, or looking for support with recurring aches and pains, Camino Chews Golden Peach "Recover" are a delicious, effective option. These plant-based fruit chews are formulated with THC and CBG for a soothing mind-body experience enhanced with hybrid-like terpenes for those times your body needs some extra TLC.

10827677578.name: Cycling Frog 10mg Seltzers Cran Raspberry
10827677578.description: Cycling Frog THC Seltzers are sparkling, juicy, and deliciously crafted beverages that deliver a sessionable, booze-free buzz. The funnest drink you’ll ever have.

10827677297.name: Cycling Frog 10mg Seltzers Ruby Grapefruit
10827677297.description: Cycling Frog THC Seltzers are sparkling, juicy, and deliciously crafted beverages that deliver a sessionable, booze-free buzz. The funnest drink you’ll ever have.

10827677388.description: Cycling Frog THC Seltzers are sparkling, juicy, and deliciously crafted beverages that deliver a sessionable, booze-free buzz. The funnest drink you’ll ever have.

5663135695.name: Dark Star 100mg Bullet Bar Nighttime
5663135695.description: An Indica based dark chocolate edible infused with THC and often CBN, designed for relaxation and sleep, featuring a rich, bittersweet taste with calming effects from terpenes like myrcene and linalool, helping users unwind and promote restful sleep.

5663135506.name: MFNY 100mg Live Rosin Gummies Sour Peach x Rainbow Beltz 2.0
5663135506.description: These Indica-based vegan, full-spectrum, cultivar-specific gummies are infused with MFNY’s premium Rainbow Beltz live rosin extract. Superior to distillate, live rosin is made via solventless extraction from premium fresh frozen plants, preserving all the natural terpenes. We use the minimum amount of sugar to highlight the fruity and candy flavors of the Rainbow Beltz, paired with natural flavors of sour peaches.

8399972293.name: NYCE 100mg Rosin Gummies Blueberry
8399972293.description: Live Hash Rosin gummies that are Indica based. Designed for nighttime use, these are perfect for relaxing and winding down.

9370378457.name: Trout & Co 100mg Ampersand Peach Mochi
9370378457.description: Ampersand is a water-soluble, solventless hash rosin powder crafted from premium, full-spectrum live rosin. Designed to dissolve under your tongue, the powder provides a fast-acting (2–15 minute) effect through lymphatic absorption rather than digestion.

5663135532.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Island Punch
5663135532.description: These potentially relaxing, island-inspired Indica gummies evoke a mouth-watering tropical punch with hints of grape, orange, cherry, and pineapple. They're also fast-acting, with a 5-15 minute onset and 2-4 hour duration.

5663135340.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Limoncello
5663135340.description: These vegan, melt-proof, hybrid edibles offering a sweet and slightly sour lemon flavor with uplifting, balanced effects, thanks to fast-acting technology for a 5-15 minute onset, making them ideal for creativity and mood boosts with a consistent, enjoyable experience.

5663135568.name: Wana 100mg Gummies New York Sunrise
5663135568.description: A fast-acting, sativa-leaning edibles with citrus (orange) and tart cherry flavors, inspired by a Tequila Sunrise and enhanced with uplifting terpenes for focus, creativity, and a smooth, balanced lift with a quick 5-15 minute onset. They are vegan, melt-proof, kosher, and use organic sweeteners, offering an energizing hybrid experience for daytime use, with effects lasting 2-4 hours.

5663135492.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Peach Bellini
5663135492.description: These fast-acting Sativa peach gummies will add some zip to your day with their inspiring blend of 30+ uplifting terpenes.

5663135551.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Pina Colada
5663135551.description: Fast-acting, indica-leaning edibles with rich pineapple and coconut flavors, using terpene-enhanced distillate for a mellow, relaxing, and sometimes sleepy effect, perfect for unwinding, often delivering quick relief within 5-15 minutes. They are vegan, gluten-free, melt-proof, made with organic sweeteners.

5663135354.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Stay Asleep
5663135354.description: A melatonin-free, cannabis-infused edible designed to provide long-lasting, uninterrupted sleep without next-day grogginess. They are formulated to address the root causes of sleeplessness, such as stress and physical tension.

5663135474.name: Wana 100mg Gummies Strawberry Margarita
5663135474.description: fast-acting, hybrid edibles with a sweet, citrusy, slightly salty flavor, featuring a 1:1 ratio of THC and CBD (or sometimes THC/CBD/CBG), enhanced with terpenes for a balanced, uplifting experience that kicks in within 5-15 minutes due to "nano-encapsulation" technology, making them vegan, gluten-free, and melt-proof.

10506410548.name: Cultured 1g Live Resin SLM
10506410548.description:
Experience the bold character of SLM Live Resin, a terpene-rich extract crafted from freshly harvested cannabis to preserve the strain's natural flavor and potency. This lively hybrid combines the zesty citrus and herbal notes of Super Lemon Haze with the creamy, earthy complexity of MAC, creating a smooth, flavorful concentrate with exceptional depth.

Flavor Profile: Bright lemon • Sweet citrus • Earthy herbs • Creamy diesel

SLM delivers an uplifting cerebral buzz paired with a balanced body relaxation. Expect a clear-headed, creative, and euphoric experience that gradually settles into a calm, comfortable finish, making it a versatile choice for any time of day.

10249740174.name: Dreaming Tree Farm Temple Balls Honey Banana
10249740174.description: Hand-rolled solventless temple ball hash made from premium Honey Banana (a Spritzer cross of the classic Honey Boo × Strawberry Banana lineage). Expect rich, dessert-like notes of ripe banana, sweet honey, tropical fruit, and subtle earthy spice, with a full-bodied, aromatic smoke that stays true to the strain’s signature flavor. The dark, polished exterior protects a sticky, resinous interior packed with terpenes (led by caryophyllene) and potent cannabinoids. Crafted via ice-water extraction of high-quality flower, gently dried, pressed, and rolled into traditional 1g temple balls, then carefully cured. A pure, traditional hash experience with modern craft quality, smooth, flavorful, and deeply satisfying.

6474775528.name: Dreaming Tree Farms 1g Rosin Black Maple

6474775605.name: Dreaming Tree Farms 1g Rosin Honey Banana

6474775568.name: Dreaming Tree Farms 1g Rosin Super Boof

5880251454.name: NYCE 1g Rosin Poddy Mouth
5880251454.description: An evenly balanced hybrid known for a flavor profile of sweet, fruity, gassy, and spicy notes with a balanced high that brings uplifting euphoria and deep relaxation, making it great for stress relief and creativity. It's a solventless live rosin from Humboldt Pound Cake x Mountain Top Mint.

9370377175.name: Trout & Co 1g Rosin Sweet Vidalia Private Reserve

6486846528.name: Umamii 1g Live Rosin Banana Pie-Paya
6486846528.description:
Banana Pie Paya Tier 1 is the purest expression of this cultivar, crafted from a single 90u–119u micron wash to isolate only the most premium trichome heads. Grown, washed, and pressed entirely in-house by Umamii, this single source live rosin is made from fresh-frozen flower using a completely solventless process, preserving the cultivar's fullest terpene expression.

The profile opens with rich banana-cream sweetness layered over warm pastry dough and smooth vanilla custard. As the experience unfolds, soft tropical fruit notes emerge alongside a delicate gassy undertone, finishing with a buttery pie crust that lingers long after the exhale. The smoke is exceptionally clean, smooth, and flavorful, delivering a refined dessert-forward profile with remarkable clarity and complexity.

Produced in extremely limited quantities, Tier 1 represents Umamii's highest standard of solventless craftsmanship. By isolating only the finest trichome heads, Banana Pie Paya Tier 1 offers unmatched purity, terpene intensity, and a true connoisseur-grade single source live rosin experience.

5663194674.name: Umamii 1g Live Rosin Papaya
5663194674.description: Indulge in the pure essence of tropical bliss with our Papaya Single Source Live Rosin, meticulously crafted from fresh-frozen Papaya buds harvested at peak ripeness. This premium solventless extract is pressed using a precise 90-micron mesh for an ultra-refined texture that's silky smooth and bursting with vibrant terpenes. Juicy ripe papaya mingles with hints of mango, citrus zest, and subtle earthy undertones, delivering a sweet, fruity exhale that's reminiscent of a sun-soaked island getaway. A balanced hybrid experience that uplifts the mind with euphoric, creative energy while gently relaxing the body.

11178169314.name: Umamii 1g Private Reserve Rosin Ninja Fruit
11178169314.description: Sensei’s genetics. Umamii’s craft. Ninja Fruit pairs bright grapefruit citrus with sweet grape notes and an earthy finish for a rich, fruit-forward dab. This hybrid may offer an uplifting, mood-brightening start that settles into relaxed, easygoing calm, a balance of mental lift and body comfort. Effects vary by person and dose. Grown, washed, and pressed at our farm in Wyoming, NY using Sensei’s genetics, this Private Reserve collaboration brings our shared dedication to craft into every solventless 1g jar.

10955786551.name: Umamii 2g Live Rosin Soap
10955786551.description:
Fresh, funky, and unmistakably Soap. This cross brings an anticipated flavor profile of cool mint, sweet herbal notes, and earthy gas, rounded out by a distinctive floral, almost soapy finish. A subtle doughy richness adds depth beneath the crisp, aromatic top notes.

The experience may bring an uplifting cerebral buzz with a happy, creative feel, followed by gentle body relaxation. Think a lively mental lift balanced by mellow physical ease, with effects varying by person and dose.

9651706434.name: Umamii Cured Resin 1g Field Notes
9651706434.description:
From Umamii's Cured Resin Summer Series...Inspired by the outdoors, Field Notes offers a bold, terpene-forward profile with warm spice, earthy herbs, and a subtle peppery kick. This balanced hybrid delivers a rich, complex flavor that's perfect for those who enjoy something beyond the ordinary.


Flavor Profile: Earthy herbs • Warm spice • Pepper • Woody finish


Experience: Clear-headed and grounded with gentle body relaxation, Field Notes provides a balanced experience that's equally suited for creative moments or unwinding after a long day.

5775690451.name: VCC Full Spectrum RSO 1g
5775690451.description: A highly potent, full-spectrum concentrate designed for versatile and precise dosing, often used by medical patients and wellness-focused consumers. The oil captures the full range of compounds found in the cannabis plant, including various cannabinoids (THC, CBD, CBG, CBC) and terpenes, to leverage the "entourage effect," where the compounds work together synergistically.

8538430302.name: Ayrloom Topicals 1000mg Rescue
8538430302.description: make it hurt so good! this cooling, tingling balm is made for muscle recovery or nagging pain points. the perfect combination of cannabis, menthol, arnica, peppermint oil + eucalyptus creates a balm that is suitable post-workout or for possibly alleviating back pain, arthritis or stiff muscles.

8376963798.name: MFNY 60ml Massage Oil Candy Rain
8376963798.description: Know why this city never sleeps? You will now. This all-natural THC-infused intimacy oil provides pleasurable sensations where applied (all we’re legally allowed to say). All Night Affair is formulated with MFNY’s top-tier Candy Rain live resin and jojoba oil, plus vanilla and ylang-ylang essential oils. Its natural terpenes can help elevate your mood, release tension, and spark full-body sensations that stretch long into the night.

5895034756.name: Papa & Barkley Balms 50mL 3:1 CBD:THC 150mg
5895034756.description: a potent, full-spectrum topical designed for intense pain relief, using a 450mg CBD/150mg THC ratio in a solventless, plant-based formula with essential oils like eucalyptus and lavender, providing warming and cooling sensations for localized muscle and joint discomfort without psychoactive effects.

5775690676.name: VCC Warrior Balm
5775690676.description: A potent, fast-acting topical balm designed for deep muscle and joint relief, featuring a balanced 1:1 ratio of 900mg THC and 900mg CBD, combined with cooling menthol, numbing camphor, emu oil, arnica, and essential oils for rapid, lasting comfort and recovery. It's known for its smooth texture and ability to soothe soreness upon contact, offering targeted pain relief without psychoactive effects.

9772344238.name: Dr. Dabber Ghost 2

9772344243.description: Crafted from ballistic nylon with a silicon front pocket to transport your eRig and your oils safely. (Compatible with all Dr. Dabber eRigs)

9772344235.name: Dr. Dabber XS
9772344235.description: Features like our original spill-proof glassware, convenient filling tool and carb cap leash make Dr. Dabber XS™ the ultimate travel companion.

8102954249.name: EG Glass 14" Beaker Bong
8102954249.description: This beaker bong measures a towering 14” inches tall and is made from thick, high-quality borosilicate glass. It features a triple pinch ice catcher at the bottom of the neck, which can fit many cubes resulting in long, icy-cool smoke sessions. The 14mm male bowl piece fits large packs of your herb, while the 6-slit diffuser downstem helps to diffuse your smoke for smoother rips. The eye-catching EG Glass Logo is located on the neck and base of the bong. No matter which style you go with, the EG Glass Beaker is guaranteed to meet all your smoking needs!

10531995223.name: Everyday Canna Co. Ranger 510 Battery
10531995223.description: The Ranger pocket battery is crafted using high quality materials, like machined aircraft grade aluminum and a premium CCELL battery. Featuring a sophisticated, yet rugged, utilitarian design.

5663135364.name: Fernway Stylus Pen Battery
5663135364.description:
An excellent vape deserves an excellent battery. Optimized to make your vapes taste better and last longer, the STYLUS is the perfect companion for your Fernway cartridge – and now with upgraded features: USB-C: For faster, more reliable power, Passthrough Charging: For an uninterrupted sesh. Use the included USB charger or any USB-C cord to recharge.

Register your stylus with Fernway's warranty program using the QR code in every box and you'll enjoy a 2-year warranty with a free replacement battery replacement in the case you break or lose your current one!

6915665054.name: Flexispot Y4 HEPA Air Purifier
6915665054.description: Designed for medium to large-sized rooms, bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and offices, the Y4 is particularly ideal for households with odors or multiple pets. This versatile air purifier effectively tackles a range of air quality challenges, including smoke, ensuring a fresh and clean environment in any space. Perfect for smokers/vapers who partake indoors and want a way to help keep their airspace clean!

9114142877.name: Funzees Hemp Grinder
9114142877.description: The Funzees 50mm Biodegradable Hemp Grinder is a compact, eco-friendly 2-piece grinder made from sustainable, recycled materials. It features an innovative tooth design meant to provide an even and fluffy grind, and is lightweight and waterproof, making it a highly practical and planet-conscious option for everyday use.
